author: gobernment
body:
With Sky Wars being polled, I have started working on Arcade. I would like your suggestions (original, please!) on gamemodes for us to use in the arcade sector. Try to keep the player count anywhere to where it can hold 6 to 18 players: I'll personally handle rotations (small maps first, then larger ones.)

So far, I have added:
Minotaur - Up to 2 players chase players running to the finish line, meeting obstacles along the way.
Carpet Bombers - 3 players bomb the users below, trying to escape the TNT. Meet/duel them at the end to win.
Ghost Squadron - Two teams fight against each other while invisible in order to win. Eliminate the enemy team.

Ideas on the list:
- King of the Ladder
- One in the Quiver

Maps would also be awesome to provide for your gamemode ideas. Thanks!

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
What about the ones we have already like Snake, Red Alert, Dragons, and OITQ?

Horse Race/Boat Race- Players race each other on horses to the finish line. 

Skyfall (Thimble)- Players take turn jumping into a small pool of water. Each space they land in becomes a block of their choice. The next players do the same, but if they don't land in the water (hits the ground hard), they do not get any points. Each successful jump is 1 point. Additional bonus points for each block directly next to it.

Hole in The Wall- A wall comes at you with holes in it. Your job is to place blocks where the holes are before the wall comes at you. 1 point for every correctly placed block. (I believe this is on Hypixel).

Bow Spleef- Players shoot arrows at the tnt blocks below players.

Parkour Masters- Players race each other to complete a parkour map. 

Dodgeball- Snowballs are thrown across at the enemy team. When they make contact with a player, that player is out. 

Pac-Man- 4 players are ghosts, the others are Pac-Man. The objective for the ghosts is to eat all the Pac-Mans. The goal for the Pac-Mans is to eat all of the Pac-Dots.

Mob Arena- Players are placed in a mob arena as mobs try to kill all the players. Each wave gets increasingly harder. The players have to survive through as many waves as they can.

Pandemic- 1 player starts as a zombie and their goal is to infect all of the other players by punching them.

Super Smash (The one from MCPVP)- Players' objective is to knock out as many of their opponents as possible. The more you get hit, the more knockback you will recieve on the next hit. Various items will be spawned on the map to help you.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Wither Escort - The defenders must escort the Wither Lord across the map and protect it from raiders. Mobs and hostile wildlife will spawn along the "Trail" and attack both raiders and defenders.

Defenders will have AI mobs like zombies and wither skeletons to help defend. Raiders will have wolves, Rebel Skeleton archers and swordsmen and rebel zombies as AI allies.

Maps must have multiple spawns and "Checkpoints" where players will spawn after a checkpoint is reached. These can be done with a special XML module and the "IDs" referencing spawns and various other things. The wither has a lot of health too and will fight back against hostiles and heal allies who come near (3 blocks).

The Culling - Players must avoid being killed and wiped out by a powerful magic user of immense powah!
You must run! Hide!

replies.author: EncryptedShoesHD
replies.body:
I don't know the name for it yet, but here's how it should look like. 


This game requires at least two teams. When you spawn, you get an equipment which is usually sword or axe, armor, bow, arrows and food. Then, you need to rush to the middle to collect gold. On the middle of the map, there's a gold spawned, which is spawning gold ingots at a specified time, so like 1 gold nugget per two seconds. Whenever you have at least one gold nugget, you can run back to your spawn point to deposit it. To make this thing even harder, you can add so they need to deposit gold ingots and not nuggets. Whenever you deposit it, you score a point for your team and get some exp, so you can later upgrade your stuff. The first team that scores enough points, wins.
